# fk-without-index

- Dialects: postgres, sqlite
- Default: on

## Why

Deleting or updating a referenced row scans the referencing table for matching rows, and joins on the foreign key scan it too. Without an index on the referencing columns both degrade to full table scans and take long locks as the table grows.

## Fix

Add an index to the model whose leading columns are the foreign key columns, then regenerate the schema.

## Exception

Tiny, static referencing tables, or a foreign key whose referenced rows are never updated or deleted and never joined through.

The same text is printed by `schemalens explain fk-without-index`. An exclusion needs a written reason. Back to the [rule index](README.md).
